title: Smiling Girl Playing Upright Piano in 1964 Living Room, B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot stamped 'JAN • 64' at the top border showing a smiling young girl seated at an upright piano, turning toward the camera with her hands poised over the keyboard. She wears a white top and a patterned skirt. The cozy mid-century interior features a low louvered credenza, a tall ceramic and wood table lamp, and a framed portrait on the wall behind her.
